title: Finite purely inseparable extensions compose
statement: Let $k\subseteq E\subseteq F$ be fields [def-pc-field-extension] such that $E/k$ and $F/E$ are finite purely inseparable extensions [def-weil-pbc-finite-purely-inseparable-extension]. Then $F/k$ is a finite purely inseparable extension.
